title: Lasso: Towards Sustainable AI-Generated Media Detection with Intel QAT On-Chip Compression
abstract: arXiv:2611.18895v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Synthetic text, images, and video are rising. Software-only detectors are power-hungry, too slow, and costly, and do not scale with demand. When software cannot scale, historically hardware often comes to the rescue. We perform the first reverse engineering of a compression accelerator--Intel QuickAssist Technology (QAT) microarchitecture and--find different amount of time on each, a novel data structure-dependent property. Using this information, we then build Lasso, a low-cost, high-performance detector for AI-generated content that turns the accelerator into a measuring instrument.   For text detection, Lasso achieves 100% accuracy on original DetectRL text and retains 92% average accuracy after paraphrasing, compared with 78% for Binoculars and 55% for DetectGPT. Across original, paraphrased, and perturbed text, it achieves 82% average accuracy, outperforming all five baselines. With topic, length, and formatting matched, accuracy

translated_title: Lasso：基于英特尔QAT片上压缩实现可持续的AI生成媒体检测
translated_abstract: 合成文本、图像和视频日益增多。纯软件检测器功耗高、速度慢、成本高昂，且无法随需求扩展。当软件无法扩展时，历史上硬件往往会来救场。我们首次对压缩加速器——英特尔QuickAssist Technology（QAT）微架构——进行了逆向工程，发现其在处理不同数据时所耗费的时间各不相同，这是一种新颖的依赖于数据结构的特性。利用这一信息，我们构建了Lasso——一个低成本、高性能的AI生成内容检测器，它将加速器转变为一种测量仪器。在文本检测方面，Lasso在原始DetectRL文本上实现了100%的准确率，并在文本改写后仍保持92%的平均准确率，相比之下Binoculars为78%，DetectGPT为55%。在原始、改写和扰动文本上，其平均准确率达到82%，超越了所有五个基线方法。在主题、长度和格式匹配的情况下，准确率…
tldr: 该论文首次对英特尔QAT压缩加速器微架构进行逆向工程，利用其处理时间随数据结构变化的特性，构建了低成本、高性能的AI生成内容检测器Lasso，在文本检测任务上显著超越现有基线方法。
en_tdlr: This paper performs the first reverse engineering of the Intel QAT compression accelerator microarchitecture and leverages its data-structure-dependent timing properties to build Lasso, a low-cost, high-performance detector for AI-generated content that significantly outperforms existing baselines in text detection.
